entities.name: Mortal Realm
entities.description: The sunlit main landscape of Theros where living mortals dwell, and the only Therosian realm directly enterable by planeswalking.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of gods, heroes and monsters that contains the Mortal Realm.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A gleaming coastal polis of temples and philosophy governed by the council known as the Twelve.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A martial polis guarding the northern frontier, governed by a monarch advised by elders.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: A polis within the Nessian Wood, ruled by a council during the absence of Karametra.

entities.name: Nessian Wood
entities.description: An ancient forest sacred to the god Nylea.

entities.name: Skophos
entities.description: The labyrinthine minotaur city governed by priests and warlord tyrants devoted to Mogis.

entities.name: Asphodel
entities.description: A necropolis of the Returned on the Despair Lands, ruled by the Aphonai.

entities.name: Odunos
entities.description: A city of the Returned who despise the living, ruled by Tymaret.

entities.name: Tymaret
entities.description: The ruler of Odunos.

entities.name: The Returned
entities.description: Undead beings who escaped the underworld at the cost of their identities.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god whose summer solstice holiday is described; he is now dead.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: The deific ruler of Setessa, currently absent.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: The huntress god to whom the Nessian Wood is sacred.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: The god worshipped in Skophos, whose eye is the blood moon.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: A trickster god worshipped by the Returned and hunted by Erebos.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The sea god who rules the Siren Sea.

entities.name: The Underworld
entities.description: The realm of the dead whose influence blights parts of the Mortal Realm.

entities.name: Siren Sea
entities.description: A vast ocean bordering western Theros.

entities.name: The Twelve
entities.description: The philosopher council that governs Meletis.

events.summary: The Returned escape the underworld via the Path of Phenax, losing their identities, and gather in the necropoleis.
events.quote: The necropoleis of Asphodel and Odunos house the Returned, undead beings who have escaped the underworld at the cost of their identities.

events.summary: Heliod has died, leaving it unclear whether his solstice holiday is still celebrated.
events.quote: whether this holiday is still celebrated after Heliod's death is unknown.

relations.quote: The Mortal Realm is the main landscape of Theros , where the living mortals dwell.

relations.note: philosopher council that governs the polis
relations.quote: Meletis is governed by the philosopher council known as the Twelve
Setessa by a Ruling Council during the absence of its deific ruler, Karametra.
